base_intake.interpretation: Canonical base intake is the preserved broad discovery baseline. It is not treated as a historical completeness proof.

within_year_temporal_skew_audit.diagnostic_slices: calendar quarters and months; audit-only, not publication units
within_year_temporal_skew_audit.assessment: No catastrophic temporal hole is visible in the base arXiv intake. Every month contains more than 3,000 unique papers. Q2 is the densest quarter and Q1 the sparsest; the material completeness risk is capped cs.LG slices plus present-day publisher-index archival loss, not an empty calendar interval.

arxiv_cap_audit.assessment: Ten month/category slices hit the configured 2,000-result ceiling, all in cs.LG; January and August did not. Base arXiv success therefore cannot establish research completeness. Material papers are checked by exact identity before annual Selection.

source_planes.notes: Base intake preserves Prefix-Tuning, Prompt Tuning, LoRA, FLAN, T0, the book-summarization human-feedback paper and OpenAI first-party book-summarization page. These establish adaptation and steering without requiring gap-fill for already-preserved lifecycle boundaries.

Base intake preserves first-party DALL-E and CLIP items plus their primary papers, ALIGN, Frozen multimodal few-shot learning, Diffusion Models Beat GANs, CogView, GLIDE and Latent Diffusion. Exact primary identities are available despite broad-category capping.

Base intake preserves Switch Transformers, ZeRO-Infinity, GLaM and Gopher primary papers, but not the material contemporary access/release boundaries for GPT-J-6B, Jurassic-1 or MT-NLG, nor a first-party Gopher announcement. Targeted first-party/maintainer records are required.

Base intake preserves APPS, the Codex technical paper and OpenAI first-party Codex research/product items. GitHub Copilot technical preview is a distinct deployed developer-interface event outside the configured base official-page watchlist and requires gap-fill.

Base intake preserves RETRO and WebGPT primary papers plus OpenAI first-party WebGPT. LaMDA dialogue framing and DeepMind first-party Gopher/RETRO chronology are absent from normalized base events and require exact first-party gap-fill.

Base intake preserves the Foundation Models report, TruthfulQA paper and OpenAI first-party item, Training Verifiers / GSM8K, the language-model ethical/social-risk taxonomy, and OpenAI behavior-curation evidence. These support evaluation and risk framing without a census of every benchmark.

Base intake preserves ZeRO-Infinity and OpenAI Triton first-party release. The configured GitHub Release watchlist contributes no normalized 2021 releases and is oriented toward projects material in later years; commit-level runtime history is not reconstructed exhaustively.

residual_limitations: Present-day official index snapshots cannot prove that every 2021 publisher item remains linked or unchanged.
Ten capped cs.LG month slices may omit non-headline research; exact checks protect material editorial anchors but do not make the full research intake exhaustive.

The configured GitHub Release collector is oriented toward projects that became material later and returned no normalized 2021 release records; commit-level or non-Release runtime history is therefore not reconstructed exhaustively.

Some 2021 product/research announcements moved or were edited after publication; exact first-party or maintainer URLs are preserved where recoverable, while later page edits remain a hindsight limitation.
A supplemental first-party page establishes the publisher-defined announcement/access boundary, not independent reproduction of vendor capability claims.

single_volume_preliminary_assessment.rationale: The year has a coherent annual arc from the post-GPT-3 pretrained model as a monolithic capability object toward a reusable substrate surrounded by adaptation/steering, multimodal generation, code interfaces, model-access surfaces, sparse/retrieval systems, and explicit evaluation/risk layers. These trajectories interact strongly enough for one annual synthesis; no H1/H2 split trigger is visible at coverage-audit stage.
